- Changed the "true" to "1" in order to be consistent with the
`Use-Soap-Jwt` header

[Issue #8601] Opportunity Summary CRUD Endpoint - Update (#9041)

## Summary

<!-- Use "Fixes" to automatically close issue upon PR merge. Use "Work
for" when UAT is required. -->
Fixes for #8601 

## Changes proposed

<!-- What was added, updated, or removed in this PR. -->
Implementing the Update Opportunity Summary endpoint as laid out in the
[Opportunity Publishing MVP Phase 2: Feature Build Out Tech
Spec](https://navasage.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/Grantsgov/pages/2613215233/Phase+2+Feature+Build+Out).

## Context for reviewers

<!-- Technical or background context, more in-depth details of the
implementation, and anything else you'd like reviewers to know about
that will help them understand the changes in the PR. -->
Endpoint Path: `PUT
/v1/grantors/opportunities/:opportunity_id/summary/:opportunity_summary_id`
- Update an opportunity summary

Parameters: `opportunity_id:uuid`, `opportunity_summary_id:uuid`

Auth: A user must have the UPDATE_OPPORTUNITY privilege for the Agency
associated with the opportunity.
